components.note: Definition entry; factorials, binomial coefficients with zero outside range, natural logs, asymptotic equivalence, fair signs and lattice L_N, Bernoulli count B_N with fixed p in [0,1], phi/Phi with stated normalization premise, ceiling/floor and empty-supremum convention all stated. Source variant (Durrett p.113: S_2n=2k counting and Stirling referral to Feller p.52) checked at Durrett PDF p.121.

All four assertions proved: log remainder by integral, odd log series with remainder to zero, scalar product limit (source Lemma 3.1.1) and triangular product limit (source Exercise 3.1.1). Source attribution checked at Durrett PDF p.122 (book p.114, Lemma 3.1.1) and PDF p.123 (book p.115, Exercise 3.1.1).

Binomial mass, mean, variance, both upper-tail bounds, lower-tail bound by failure count, Gaussian Mills bounds and asymptotic all proved. Feller VI.3 (3.4)-(3.6) checked at Feller PDF p.166 (book p.151, with p.150 at PDF p.165); VII.1 Lemma 2 (1.7)-(1.8) at PDF p.190 (book p.175) and its proof (1.9) at PDF p.194 (book p.179).

Finite constant via d_n and exact series, both Robbins bounds with the explicit polynomial check 24n-23>0, Feller's constant determination (central ratio, interval mass with Riemann sums, tail bound, Mills bounds, R to infinity) written at annex 171-243, independent cosine-integral route at 245-253, and the 1/(12n)-1/(360n^3) refinement with explicit 6/(5n^5) bound at 255-297. Feller II.9 (9.1)-(9.15) checked at Feller PDF pp.67-69 (book pp.52-54) and the VII.2 footnote-3 constant argument at PDF p.195 (book p.180).

Exact H(u) formula, source product limits including k<=0, uniform log remainder K_A/n with the three explicit bounds, odd-parity lattice version via last-sign recursion, wrong-parity and extreme-point cases. Source Theorem 3.1.2 checked at Durrett PDF p.122 (book p.114) and factorization (3.1.2) at PDF p.121 (book p.113).

Exact index formula incl. empty sums, Riemann-sum limit with explicit error, even-limit/odd-step source route with explicit sandwich, strict endpoints, singletons, CDF and infinite endpoints by Chebyshev cutoffs. Source Theorem 3.1.3 and the S_{2n+1}=S_{2n}+-1 remark checked at Durrett PDF p.123 (book p.115).
Definition: Poisson masses for lambda>0, point mass at lambda=0, independent parameter-one X_i and T_n distinguished from S_N.
Normalization via Taylor remainder, mean and variance via factorial moments, lambda=0 case, exact law of T_n via multinomial counting identity incl. k=0.

Exact factorial formula with J(u), explicit uniform log bound (2A^3/3+A)/sqrt(n)+1/(6n), moving-k source limit, Riemann-sum interval limit, exact thresholds, Chebyshev cutoffs for CDF and infinite endpoints, strict endpoints and singletons. Source Exercise 3.1.2 (with its interval consequence marked as not part of the exercise) checked at Durrett PDF p.123 (book p.115).
Definition: gamma on [-1,1] with 0log0=0, I(a) for a>0, log0=-infinity convention. Matches gamma(a) in Durrett Exercise 3.1.3 (PDF p.123).

Point-mass rate via exact Stirling factorization at u_n=k_n/n, explicit lattice ratio bound (1-a)/(1+a), geometric sandwich, and the extended endpoint cases a<=0, a=1, a>1. Source Exercise 3.1.3 and the hint P(S_n>=k)<=CP(S_n=k) checked at Durrett PDF p.123 (book p.115).

Point-mass rate, ratio n/(k+1)<=1/a, geometric comparison inequalities, a=1 proved separately via central mass, 0<a<1 via Chebyshev, a<=0 surely. Source Exercise 3.1.4 checked at Durrett PDF p.123 (book p.115); cross-reference Exercise 2.7.3 at PDF p.120 (book p.112).

Exact formula with D(t||p), Taylor bound with explicit M_p, uniform local limit with explicit remainder orders, interval limit by Riemann sums, Chebyshev tail, CDF convergence, degenerate p=0,1 case; explicitly labelled as an extension of Durrett's fair-sign formulation.

Relative error monotone to zero with diverging absolute error, n=5 numerics, both rate values, dependence counterexample, endpoint relative-ratio failure sqrt(pi n)(e/4)^n with e<3 proved, and p_N=1/N failure via atom e^{-1} and closed-set portmanteau. Feller's 5! approx 118.019 and percentage-error remark checked at Feller PDF p.67 (book p.52).

Proof-boundary entry stating the supplied Durrett Section 3.1 scope (Lemma 3.1.1, Theorems 3.1.2-3.1.3, Exercises 3.1.1-3.1.4), Feller II.9 with its constant determination, the binomial extension as an explicit extension, and the next distinct presentations. Each listed item is present at the cited entries above.

defect_observations.detail: The constant argument states the log-ratio expansion -k^2/n+E_{n,k} with |E_{n,k}|<=(2/n^2)sum j^2 directly; the factor decomposition (1-(j-1)/n)/(1+j/n) and the identity sum(2j-1)=k^2 are not written out. The resulting explicit bound is stated, so not treated as a missing step.

The binomial interval limit is obtained by naming the Riemann-sum ingredients (mesh 1/sigma_N, uniform local bound, uniform continuity) rather than restating the interval-length-plus-two-mesh error bound written at annex 399-415.
Divergence of n!-A_n: the claim that (n/2)^{floor(n/2)} grows faster than 12n+2 is asserted without an explicit inequality.
Refers to Theorem~\ref{thm:p15-weak-elementary-asymptotics}, which is a Lemma (hblemma at handbook/parts/p15/weak-convergence-of-laws.tex:330). Supplementary second route only.
'previously proved Gaussian integral' (and annex line 90 'previously proved normalization of phi') carry no \ref to the proving entry.
Feller locator pp.51-54: II.9 begins on p.52 (PDF p.67); p.51 holds section 8 including expansion (8.11) used in (9.9). Durrett's own referral is to p.52. Not an unsupported locator.
